ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; approximately 0.10:1.0 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface, excluding water spray.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark-intensity surface with distinct, isolated high-contrast white circular rings (approx. 10-20 pixels diameter) scattered across both lobes. Mottled mid-intensity (grey) pixels are concentrated in the lower central regions adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, symmetrical U-shaped depression with an approximate interior pixel angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 50 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels along the entire continuous linear boundary, showing greater amplitude at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex upward curvature on the superior-outer edges of both lobes, transitioning to a slight concave trajectory as it nears the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread spatial detection of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel rings; notable cluster density on the upper left lobe and the distal right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, oriented approximately 45 degrees from the vertical axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular high-contrast white cluster (likely barnacle colonization) on the terminal tip of the right lobe; extensive circular depletion scarring across the entire fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct 'annular' scar morphology characterized by dark centers surrounded by high-intensity white perimeters.
